# 03 Main Evaluation

**Purpose:** Evaluate all trained models on the temporal validation set, producing the metrics in Table 2 (AUROC, AUPRC, sensitivity, specificity, accuracy) and the calibration/decision curve analyses for Figure 3 and 4.

We will also perform bootstrap for confidence intervals, DeLong tests, and continuous NRI.

import sys
sys.path.append("..")

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import yaml
import joblib
from pathlib import Path
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score, average_precision_score

from src.preprocess import load_and_split_data, preprocess_structured, preprocess_text, get_labels
from src.text_encoder import TextEncoder
from evaluation.metrics import compute_all_binary_metrics
from evaluation.calibration import compute_calibration_metrics
from evaluation.bootstrap import bootstrap_confidence_intervals
from evaluation.statistical_tests import delong_test, continuous_nri
from visualization.plot_roc import plot_roc_overall
from visualization.plot_calibration import plot_calibration_curve
from visualization.plot_decision_curve import plot_decision_curve

with open("../config.yaml") as f:
    config = yaml.safe_load(f)
threshold = config["evaluation"]["optimal_threshold"]
n_bootstrap = config["evaluation"]["n_bootstrap"]
output_dir = Path(config["output_paths"]["results_dir"])
output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
fig_dir = Path(config["output_paths"]["figures_dir"])
fig_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
random_state = config["random_state"]

# Load data and models
train_df, val_df = load_and_split_data(
    config["data"]["raw_data_path"],
    training_cutoff_date=config["data"]["training_cutoff_date"],
    validation_start_date=config["data"]["validation_start_date"],
    random_state=random_state,
)
X_train_raw, X_val_raw, scaler = preprocess_structured(train_df, val_df)
train_texts, val_texts = preprocess_text(train_df, val_df)
y_train, y_val = get_labels(train_df, val_df)

# Load models
deeptriage = joblib.load("../outputs/models/deeptriage_cn.pkl")
vit_xgb = joblib.load("../outputs/models/vitals_only_xgb.pkl")
rf = joblib.load("../outputs/models/random_forest.pkl")
text_lr = joblib.load("../outputs/models/text_only_lr.pkl")
# TabNet
from src.tabnet_model import TabNetWrapper
tabnet = TabNetWrapper()
tabnet.load("../outputs/models/tabnet")

# Clinical scores
val_scores = pd.read_csv("../outputs/models/clinical_scores_val.csv")

print("All models loaded.")

# Generate predictions
text_enc = deeptriage.text_encoder  # reuse encoder
val_embeddings = text_enc.encode(val_texts.tolist())

preds = {
    "DeepTriage-CN": deeptriage.predict_proba(val_texts.tolist(), X_val_raw),
    "TabNet": tabnet.predict_proba(X_val_raw)[:, 1],
    "XGBoost (Vitals-only)": vit_xgb.predict_proba(X_val_raw),
    "Random Forest": rf.predict_proba(X_val_raw),
    "Text-Only (BERT+LR)": text_lr.predict_proba(val_embeddings),
}

# For clinical scores, we use raw normalized scores as 'probabilities'
preds["NEWS2"] = val_scores["NEWS2"].values / 20.0
preds["MEWS"] = val_scores["MEWS"].values / 15.0
preds["ESI"] = (6 - val_scores["ESI"].values) / 5.0  # inverted so higher = more severe

print("Predictions generated.")

# Compute metrics for all models
results = []
for name, y_scores in preds.items():
    metrics = compute_all_binary_metrics(y_val, y_scores, threshold)
    metrics["Model"] = name
    results.append(metrics)
results_df = pd.DataFrame(results).set_index("Model")
results_df.round(3).to_csv(output_dir / "table2_metrics.csv")
results_df

# Bootstrap CI for AUROC/AUPRC (main models)
main_models = ["DeepTriage-CN", "TabNet", "XGBoost (Vitals-only)", "NEWS2", "ESI"]
ci_results = {}
for name in main_models:
    ci = bootstrap_confidence_intervals(y_val, preds[name], n_bootstrap=n_bootstrap, random_seed=random_state)
    ci_results[name] = ci
pd.DataFrame(ci_results).T.to_csv(output_dir / "bootstrap_cis.csv")
ci_results

# DeLong test: DeepTriage-CN vs others
print("DeLong p-values vs DeepTriage-CN:")
for name in ["TabNet", "XGBoost (Vitals-only)", "NEWS2", "ESI"]:
    z, p = delong_test(y_val, preds["DeepTriage-CN"], preds[name])
    print(f"  {name}: p = {p:.4f}")

# Continuous NRI vs NEWS2 and ESI
nri_news2 = continuous_nri(y_val, preds["NEWS2"], preds["DeepTriage-CN"])
nri_esi = continuous_nri(y_val, preds["ESI"], preds["DeepTriage-CN"])
print(f"NRI vs NEWS2: total={nri_news2[0]:.2f}, events={nri_news2[1]:.2f}, nonevents={nri_news2[2]:.2f}")
print(f"NRI vs ESI:   total={nri_esi[0]:.2f}, events={nri_esi[1]:.2f}, nonevents={nri_esi[2]:.2f}")

# Calibration of DeepTriage-CN
cal_metrics = compute_calibration_metrics(y_val, preds["DeepTriage-CN"])
print("Calibration metrics:", cal_metrics)
pd.Series(cal_metrics).to_csv(output_dir / "calibration_metrics.csv")

# Figures
# Prepare ROC data for Figure 2a
from sklearn.metrics import roc_curve
roc_data = {}
for name, s in preds.items():
    fpr, tpr, _ = roc_curve(y_val, s)
    auroc = roc_auc_score(y_val, s)
    roc_data[name] = {"fpr": fpr, "tpr": tpr, "auroc": auroc}

plot_roc_overall(roc_data, save_path=str(fig_dir / "figure2a_roc_overall.tiff"))

# Calibration curve (Figure 3)
plot_calibration_curve(y_val, preds["DeepTriage-CN"], brier_score=cal_metrics["brier"],
                       save_path=str(fig_dir / "figure3_calibration.tiff"))

# Decision curve (Figure 4)
plot_decision_curve(y_val, preds["DeepTriage-CN"], news2_scores=val_scores["NEWS2"].values,
                    save_path=str(fig_dir / "figure4_decision_curve.tiff"))

print("Main figures generated.")
